validation_rules.overview:
Validation ensures bobathon materials are complete, consistent, and ready to deliver. Always validate before marking work as complete.
CRITICAL FOR SELLERS: Lab validation prevents negative client impressions by ensuring all materials work correctly before delivery. Failed labs damage credibility and product perception.

todo_tracking.description: Use update_todo_list to track validation progress. This provides visual feedback and ensures all mandatory validation steps are completed.
todo_tracking.validation_todo_template: [ ] Run lab validation [ ] Run schedule validation [ ] Run documentation validation [ ] Run consistency validation [ ] Run quality checks [ ] Generate validation report
todo_tracking.when_to_create: Create or update the todo list when starting validation workflow
todo_tracking.when_to_update: Update after completing each validation step

validation_importance.reason: Prevents technical failures during client delivery
Ensures professional quality and seller credibility
Catches syntax errors, broken paths, and missing dependencies
Verifies realistic timing and appropriate difficulty
Confirms all placeholder text has been replaced
validation_importance.impact: A single failed lab exercise can undermine the entire bobathon and damage Bob's reputation

when_to_validate.trigger: After generating or customizing any lab materials
when_to_validate.mandatory: Validation is MANDATORY before any client delivery

field.name: opportunity_number
field.error_message: Invalid opportunity number format. Must be exactly 18 alphanumeric characters.
field.description: Salesforce opportunity number for tracking and reconciliation. This must be collected and validated before any bobathon setup begins.

field.name: name
field.validation: Must not be empty or placeholder like "[Client Name]"

field.name: primary_language
field.validation: Must be specific language, not placeholder

field.name: infrastructure
field.validation: Must specify cloud provider or on-premise

section.name: use_cases
section.validation: Must have at least 3 use cases
At least 2 must be high priority
Each must have name, description, priority, estimated_time

field.name: description
field.validation: Clear explanation of what to accomplish

field.name: priority
field.validation: Must be: high, medium, or low

field.name: date
field.validation: Must be valid date format YYYY-MM-DD

section.name: labs
section.validation: Each lab must have id, name, duration, difficulty, objectives

check.name: timing_adds_up
check.description: Verify schedule timing is mathematically correct

check.name: use_cases_fit_time
check.description: Ensure use cases fit within Lab 3 time allocation
check.warning: If close to limit, warn about buffer time for questions

lab_technical_validation.overview: Technical validation ensures labs work correctly and won't fail during delivery. This is CRITICAL for maintaining seller credibility and positive client impressions.

check.name: syntax_correctness
check.validation: No syntax errors in any code files

check.name: executability
check.validation: All dependencies are listed and available
Setup instructions are complete and accurate
File paths are correct and relative
check.severity: CRITICAL - Participants won't be able to complete labs

check.name: starter_code_quality
check.description: Starter code is appropriate for participants
check.validation: Provides enough structure without giving away solution

check.name: solution_completeness
check.description: Solutions are complete and demonstrate best practices

file_reference_validation.overview: Ensure all files referenced in lab instructions either exist or have clear creation instructions. This prevents participants from being blocked by missing files during the bobathon.

check.name: referenced_files_exist
check.description: All file paths mentioned in instructions are valid
check.validation: Check that referenced files exist in the project structure
Verify file paths are correct and accessible
Ensure no broken references to non-existent files
check.severity: CRITICAL - Missing files block lab progress

check.name: creation_instructions_provided
check.description: Files that don't exist have clear creation instructions
check.validation: If a file is referenced but doesn't exist, instructions must explain how to create it
Creation instructions must be complete and actionable
Instructions must specify exact file path and content structure
check.severity: CRITICAL - Participants need to know how to create required files
check.example_good: "Create a new file `src/config.json` with the following structure: ```json { "apiUrl": "https://api.example.com", "timeout": 5000 } ```"
check.example_bad: "Update the config file" (no path or creation instructions)

check.name: starter_code_availability
check.description: Starter code files are provided or have generation instructions
check.validation: If lab references starter code, it must be included in the project
Alternatively, provide clear instructions to generate starter code
Starter code must be in correct location with proper structure
check.severity: HIGH - Missing starter code frustrates participants

check.name: resource_file_completeness
check.description: All resource files referenced are complete and accurate
check.validation: resources/cheat-sheet.md has relevant commands for client's tech stack
No placeholder content in resource files
check.severity: HIGH - Incomplete resources reduce bobathon effectiveness

check.name: external_dependencies
check.description: External files or resources are accessible
check.validation: URLs to external resources are valid and accessible
API endpoints referenced are available or have mock alternatives
Sample data files are included or downloadable

validation_process.step: Extract all file references from lab instructions
Check if each referenced file exists in the project
For existing files, verify they are complete and not placeholders
For non-existent files, verify creation instructions are provided
Validate all URLs and external resources are accessible
Report any missing files or incomplete instructions

file_reference_patterns.pattern: Inline file mentions: "in the config.json file"
Command references: "run npm install in package.json"

if_file_missing.option: Create the file with appropriate content
Add clear creation instructions to the lab
Remove the reference if not essential

if_instructions_unclear.action: Include exact file path and content structure

check.name: clarity
check.validation: No placeholder text like [TODO] or [FILL IN]
All file paths are specific and correct
All commands are complete and executable

check.name: tech_stack_alignment
check.severity: HIGH - Mismatched tech confuses and frustrates

check.name: realistic_duration
check.warning: Too complex for time = participant failure and frustration

check.name: buffer_time
check.description: Includes time for questions and issues
check.recommendation: Add 20-30% buffer for questions, troubleshooting, discussion

check.name: dependencies_available
check.validation: API endpoints are accessible or mocked

check.name: difficulty_progression
check.validation: Lab 3 applies skills to real scenarios

validation_workflow_reference.description: For detailed validation workflow, see the validate_lab_materials workflow in 1_workflow.xml. This workflow provides step-by-step validation process including automated checks and manual review points.

placeholder_detection.action: If found, ask user to provide specific values

required_elements.element: Prerequisites section with Bob installation instructions
Installation steps for macOS, Linux, and Windows
Objectives specific to client's tech stack

checks.check: Prerequisites section exists and includes Bob installation
All three platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows) are covered
No generic "Python" examples if client uses Java
File paths match client's project structure
Commands use client's build tools (Maven, npm, etc.)
Examples are more complex than Lab 1
Uses client's actual patterns and conventions

required_elements.element: Scenarios based on client's use cases
Real business problems from client's domain

checks.check: All high-priority use cases are addressed
Scenarios use client's actual codebase structure
Total time fits within Lab 3 allocation

general_lab_checks.check: All code examples are syntactically correct
File paths are realistic for client's project
Commands will work in client's environment

check.name: breaks_included
check.rule: For 6+ hours: Include lunch break (45-60 min)
For 3+ hours: Include at least one 10-15 min break

content_checks.check: All use cases from config are addressed in schedule
Lab timing in schedule matches lab definitions

check.name: tech_stack_consistency
check.description: Technology references match across all files
check.validation: All code examples use same language/frameworks

check.name: use_case_coverage
check.description: All use cases are addressed in materials
check.validation: Each use case in config appears in Lab 3

check.name: timing_consistency
check.validation: Lab durations in config match schedule
Use case times in config match Lab 3 scenarios

check.name: terminology_consistency
check.description: Terms and names are used consistently

check.name: completeness
check.description: All sections are filled out, no TODOs remain

good_examples.example: Update the timeout value in config/settings.json to 30 seconds
Fix the null pointer exception in getUserData() on line 45
Add a validateEmail() function to src/utils/validation.py

check.name: relevance
check.description: Content is relevant to client's needs
check.validation: Tools and frameworks match client's stack

checks.check: File reference validation (all referenced files exist or have creation instructions)

step.details: Lab validation is MANDATORY before any client delivery. This prevents technical failures and ensures professional quality.

step.todo_update: Mark "Run schedule validation" as completed after all schedule checks pass
step.details: Schedule validation ensures realistic timing and proper content flow. This is critical for successful delivery within time constraints.

step.todo_update: Mark "Run documentation validation" as completed after all documentation checks pass

checks.check: Email templates populated with correct information
Survey questions relevant to client context

step.details: Documentation validation ensures all client-facing materials are professional, complete, and ready for delivery without additional editing.

step.todo_update: Mark "Run consistency validation" as completed after all consistency checks pass
Mark "Run quality checks" as completed after all quality checks pass
Mark "Generate validation report" as completed after report is generated

section.name: summary
section.item: Critical issues that must be fixed

ask_followup_question.question: I found [X] issues that need attention. Would you like me to fix them?

follow_up.suggest: Show me the issues first, then I'll decide

error.message: Required field '{field_name}' is missing or empty in {file_name}
error.action: Ask user to provide the value
Ask user to provide specific value
Update lab to use correct tech stack

error.message: Use case '{use_case_name}' from config not found in Lab 3
error.action: Add scenario for this use case

error.message: File '{file_path}' referenced in {lab_name} does not exist
error.action: Either create the file or add clear instructions on how to create it

error.message: File '{file_path}' referenced in {lab_name} doesn't exist and no creation instructions provided
error.action: Add step-by-step instructions for creating this file, including exact path and content structure

error.message: Resource file '{file_path}' contains placeholder content or is incomplete
error.action: Complete the resource file with actual content relevant to the client's tech stack

error.message: External resource '{url}' referenced in {lab_name} is not accessible
error.action: Verify URL is correct, provide alternative, or include resource locally
